summary.text: Judd Lawler is a Republican state representative from Iowa House District 91 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as including work as an assistant U.S. Attorney and legal writing coach.

paragraphs.text: Judd Lawler earned a bachelor's degree from Yale University in 1995 and a law degree from the Georgetown University Law Center in 1998.
His career experience includes working as a legal writing coach, speaker, adviser and assistant U.S. Attorney.
Lawler defeated Adam Grier in the June 4, 2024 Republican primary for Iowa House District 91 and Jay Gorsh in the November 5, 2024 general election, succeeding Brad Sherman.

For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia shows him as vice chair of the House Judiciary Committee and assigned to the House Agriculture, House Appropriations, House Commerce and House Government Oversight committees.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 Republican primary and faces Democrat Mark Divitt in the general election.
